Gloam

v1.100 · 6 families
The rule

One pen, held at 45°

Gloam pretends every pixel was laid by a broad nib. Strokes that travel ↗ come out thin; strokes that travel ↘ come out thick. That single rule settles every corner, dot and diagonal in the font.

2 px — the nib’s flat1 px — the nib’s edge
What’s inside

Built for the screen it lives on

357

glyphs

Latin-1 and the core of Extended-A: Finnish, Nordic, German, French, Polish, Czech, Turkish, Romanian, Hungarian, Icelandic.

Aaa

Six families

Gloam and its 1-px skeleton, Bone, in Regular, Narrow and Mono. Plus Lantern colour versions of both: shadow, halo, fill and a highlight on every top edge.

Six palettes

Ember, Moss, Frost, Ghost, Blood, Bone — baked into the font. Switch with one line of CSS: font-palette.

16×

Pixel-true

1 px = 100 units on a 1600 UPM grid. Set it at 16, 32, 48, 64… and every edge lands on a real pixel.

╔═╗

UI-ready

41 box-drawing, block and shade glyphs on a strict 8×16 cell, plus arrows, cursors, suits and six game icons.

.ttf

TTF · OTF · WOFF2

Desktop, web and engine. Sources ship as plain ASCII bitmaps, so you can redraw a glyph in a text editor.

Gloam Bone

The skinny cut

Strip the flesh and keep the bones. Every stroke is one pixel, but the nib still decides the shape: bowls still lean, branches still rise on the thin diagonal, and dots are still ticks.

Languages

  
Marked letters, same nib

Gloam v1.100

      
All six families in TTF and WOFF2 (plus OTF for the outline ones), the ASCII glyph sources, the build scripts and a README.

      

        
        
        
        
        
      

      

      
@font-face { font-family: "Gloam";
  src: url(Gloam-Regular.woff2) format("woff2"); }
@font-face { font-family: "Gloam Lantern";
  src: url(GloamLantern-Regular.woff2) format("woff2"); }
@font-palette-values --frost {
  font-family: "Gloam Lantern"; base-palette: 2; }

h1   { font: 64px/1 "Gloam Lantern"; font-palette: --frost; }
body { font: 16px/24px "Gloam Bone"; }
pre  { font: 16px/1 "Gloam Bone Mono"; }
